operations.title: Flavor boundary correspondence S3 cubed symmetry audit
Flavor boundary correspondence arrows are not generated by declared permutation and rephasing symmetries
operations.summary: Among four boundary arrows, two lower supports are not S3^3-isomorphic. The two same-support cases have only the identity support automorphism and surviving log-magnitude residual 5.604. Zero arrows are permutation/rephasing candidates.

operations.title: Flavor boundary arrows supply coefficient/readout correspondence data beyond carrier support symmetry
operations.summary: The equal-readout correspondence compactifies to lower-support faces, but its induced arrows are not predeclared support symmetries. Their algebraic relation must be derived as sector-specific coefficient data.

operations.title: Eliminate surviving magnitudes to derive the lower-support flavor correspondence ideal
operations.summary: Construct the minimal algebraic ideal relating the two limiting lower-support presentations and separate carrier incidence equations from new coefficient/readout relations.
